data.title: Mustango
data.content: A multimodal LLM  designed for controlled music generation. Mustango leverages Latent Diffusion Model (LDM), Flan-T5, and musical features. Open source model available through Hugging Face with accompanying research publication. Developed with high degree of human user maleability as core goal.

data.title: synplant 2
data.content: Synplant is an audio plug-in tool takes a genetic twist on sound design by moving beyond traditional knob-twisting and dial-adjusting, emphasizing exploration and discovery. Genopatch crafts synth patches from audio recordings, using AI to find optimal synth settings based on your source sample. As the strands in the user interface sprout and grow, they generate patches that increasingly match the chosen audio. Synplant is proprietary and subscription-based.

data.title: Stable Audio
data.content: Text-to-audio and audio-to-audio proprietary generative tool from Stability AI.

data.title: RAVE
data.content: A Realtime Audio Variational autoEncoder for neural synthesis. Open source and available on Github. Compatible with Max 8 or DAWs.

data.title: Neutone
data.content: Neutone is a suite of tools comprised of Morpho, a realtime tone morphing plug-in for DAWs, and Cocoon, a cloud service for training unique models that Morpho can then support. They open source part of their capability through their software development kit: tool for researchers that enables them to wrap their own audio models and run them in a DAW using our Neutone Plugin. They provide a model card for specific models, and train only on public domain or Creative Commons data.
